title: Chicanos Motorcycle Club
reason: Only 3 pages fetched OK (Morgenpost and Welt 2007, which carry the same report of one Berlin brawl, and a 2008 Berlin police press release reposted by a law firm). Together they cover two Berlin incidents, no court outcome, nothing on the club's founding, spread to other countries, or later history. Those later facts sit only on pages I could not open (Tagesspiegel, BZ 403/404, Swedish, Norwegian, Dutch and German local papers listed in wiki-leads.txt) and the search engines then stopped answering. Cannot reach 1,000 words of sourced content without padding.
